tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Published Zolva agents with their return, return vs simply holding the same markets, worst drop and trade count. Paper trading only.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One published agent: settings, hourly value vs holding for 7 days, open positions, latest trades, and every decision of the last 24 hours with its reason.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market Zolva prices on Robinhood Chain: latest hourly price, 1 hour to 30 day changes, a 7 day sparkline and how many agents trade it. Perps (venue perps, symbols like BTC-PERP) also carry their funding rate.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market: up to 30 days of hourly closes and the published agents trading it.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: Trades by published agents over the last 48 hours, newest first, each with the agent's own reason.

labels.name: get_market
labels.description: One market: up to 30 days of hourly closes, the published agents trading it, and its Longbow lending market if any (longbow: { lltvPct, borrowAprPct, availableUsdg, feedFrozen, url } or null; rates change, not investment advice).

labels.name: recent_activity
labels.description: Trades by published agents over the last 48 hours, newest first, each with the agent's own reason.

labels.name: get_consensus
labels.description: Statistics, per market: how many Tested published paper agents (rules that passed Zolva's 6 year backtest) are long, short or in cash, and what they did in the newest hour. Returns the agent count each market is based on and says when it is too few. Paper trading, not investment advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_markets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
